paite: Theigige in, Aw TOUPA, ka tung ua hong tung; ahon kouna uh en inla, mu in.
heading: Hehpihna Ngen A Thumna
english: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us: Look, and see our reproach.

paite: Ka gouluah uh mikhual kiang a hei ahi a, ka innte uh gamdang mite lam ah.
english: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, Our houses to aliens.

paite: Tagah leh pabei ka hi ua, ka nute uh meithai bang ahi uh.
english: We are orphans and fatherless; Our mothers are as widows.

paite: Ka tui dawn ding uh sum in ka lei ua; ka singte uh kou lak a zuak in a-om hi.
english: We have drunken our water for money; Our wood is sold to us.

paite: Ka ngawngzang uah kou hon delhte a-om ua, ka bah ua, khawlna ka nei kei uh.
english: Our pursuers are on our necks: We are weary, and have no rest.

paite: Aiguptate leh Assuriate kiang ah, tanghou a lungkim ding in ka kipia uh.
english: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, To the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

paite: Ka pipute uh akhial ua, a-om kei uh; agitlouhna uh kou ka pua uh.
english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more; We have borne their iniquities.

paite: Sikhate'n ka tung uah vai ahawm ua; akhut ua kipan kou hon tankhe ding kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: Servants rule over us: There is none to deliver us out of their hand.

paite: Ka hinna uh lauthawnna toh ka tanghou uh ka mu ua gamdai namsau ziak in.
english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, Because of the sword of the wilderness.

paite: Thuk bang in ka vun uh avom a nakpitak a kialna ziak in.
english: Our skin is black like an oven, Because of the burning heat of famine.

paite: Zion a numeite asual ua, Judah khopite a nungakte.
english: They ravished the women in Zion, The virgins in the cities of Judah.

paite: Akhut un lalte khailup in a-om ua, upa melte zahtak in a-om kei hi.
english: Princes were hanged up by their hand: The faces of elders were not honored.

paite: Tangvalte'n khawl apua ua, naupangte sing nuai ah akisui uh.
english: The young men bare the mill; The children stumbled under the wood.

paite: Kongpi a kipan upate akhawl ua, alasakna ua kipan in tangvalte akhawl uh.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, The young men from their music.

paite: Ka lungtang kipahna uh atawp a, ka lamna uh dahna asuak hi.
english: The joy of our heart is ceased; Our dance is turned into mourning.

paite: Ka lu ua kipan ka lallukhu uh akia a, ka khelh ziak un, ka tung uh agik hi!
english: The crown is fallen from our head: Woe to us! for we have sinned.

paite: Hiai ziak in ka lungtang uh abah a; hiai thilte ziak in ka mitte uh amial hi.
english: For this our heart is faint; For these things our eyes are dim;

paite: Hihsiat a om, Zion Tang ziak in; sehalte atung ah avak uh.
english: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: The foxes walk on it.

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang tangtawn in na om gige; na laltutphah khang khat a kipan in khang khat tan in a-om hi.
english: You, Yahweh, remain forever; Your throne is from generation to generation.

paite: Bangziak a tangtawn a hon mangngilh a, hichi tantan hon nungngatsan na hia?
english: Why do you forget us forever, And forsake us so long time?

paite: Nang lam hon ngasak in, Aw TOUPA huchi in bawlhoih nawn in ka om ding uh; nidanglai bang in ka nite uh thaksak in,
english: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we shall be turned. Renew our days as of old.

paite: ka tung ua heh lua a, hon pum nawlkhin na hih kei ngalleh.
english: But you have utterly rejected us; You are very angry against us.
